title: Portuguese Chicken Wrap
description: A spicy chicken wrap with a blend of Indian and Portuguese flavors, wrapped in a warm, wilted wrap.

ingredients.name: portuguese chicken masala
ingredients.notes: available at most Indian grocery stores

instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
2. In a bowl, mix together chicken breast, portuguese chicken masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, turmeric, garam masala, and red chili powder.
3. Add yogurt to the bowl and mix well.
4. Add the mixture to the preheated pan and cook for 5-6 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
6. Assemble the wrap by placing the cooked chicken in the center of the wrap, followed by a sprinkle of fresh cilantro.
7. Drizzle ghee or vegetable oil over the chicken and wrap.
9. Garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
10. Serve with your favorite chutney or raita, if desired.
